newsitem.title: USA: TRW gets approval for satellite phone system.
newsitem.headline: TRW gets approval for satellite phone system.

text.p: The Federal Communications Commission has given TRW Inc. final approval to build and operate the Odyssey satellite-based global cell phone system, the company said Wednesday.

The company said in a statement that Odyssey is a proposed personal communications satellite services system that will allow subscribers equipped with only a pocket telephone to reach any phone on Earth, from anywhere on the planet.
The system, which is scheduled to begin in the year 2001, would also provide fax, computer data, and short message services, it said.
TRW said Odyssey Telecommunications International Inc., which has TRW and Canada's Teleglobe Inc. as founding stockholders, is developing the patented Odyssey system.
